<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 8"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Rupture Stomp](/Feats.aspx?ID=4178) <actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=12" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Highhelm](/Sources.aspx?ID=204) pg. 111

**Archetype** [Stalwart Defender](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=205)

**Frequency**
once per day

**Prerequisites**
[Stalwart Defender Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=4172)

**Requirements**
You are in Tenacious Stance.

</column>

---

Every dwarf knows that the rock they walk upon can be either a best friend or a treacherous path. With a heavy impact of your armored heel, you crack the ground underneath you. The ground within a 10-foot emanation becomes [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=453). If you are a master or better in the armor you are wearing, this becomes greater difficult terrain. The cracked ground settles and reverts to normal terrain after 1 minute.

**Special** At 16th level, you can take this feat again. If you do, you can use it once per hour instead of once per day.
name: Rupture Stomp
